correctness.rationale: For the exact three-compartment Mondal–Sarkar–Sk ODE with X(0)>0, S(0)+I(0)>0, strictly positive fear K, d4>d3 and c1 f(L)=d3, summing predator equations cancels transmission, treatment and recovery: Pdot=[c1 f(X)-d3]S-(d4-d3)I. Logistic prey comparison makes the positive part of the predator growth integrable, so P has a finite limit; if positive, positive fear bounds prey strictly below L, forcing P to decay exponentially, a contradiction. Hence P->0, X->L. The infected fraction I/P decays exponentially, and stable prey-mode slaving yields (X-L)/P->-B/(r-d1), where B=rLK+f(L). Thus tS->(r-d1)/[c1 fprime(L) B] and t(L-X)->1/[c1 fprime(L)], independent of K. Independent exact rational coefficients for K=1/2 and 1/4 yield tS=1/2 and 3/5, respectively, but both prey deficits 3/2. The full global result rests on the comparison and damping proof, not the finite checks.
